exposure: Predicted chance of success of trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: Women with a single prior nonelective cesarean delivering a term singleton in 2012 at a tertiary care hospital
finding: Almost four in ten women with a history of nonelective primary cesarean and a very high predicted likelihood of VBAC choose elective repeat cesarean.
mod_finding: Spontaneous labor was strongly associated with choosing to undergo a trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC).
